summary.text: John-Michael Parker, a Democrat, has represented District 101 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since January 6, 2021, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Madison, Connecticut, graduated from Daniel Hand High School in 2006, and earned a bachelor's degree in molecular, cellular, and developmental biology from Yale University in 2010.
His career experience includes working as a teacher, artist and nonprofit executive.
